d.d: Any plant of the labiate genus Thymus, such as garden thyme (Thymus vulgaris), a warm, pungent aromatic, that is much used to give a relish to seasoning and soups.
Of or relating to the thymus gland
The nucleoside consisting of a combination of deoxyribose and thymine
A heterocyclic base, 5-methylpyrimidine-2,4(1H,3H)-dione; it pairs with adenine in DNA.

Ellipsis of thymus gland (“A ductless gland, consisting mainly of lymphatic tissue, located behind the top of the breastbone. It is most active during puberty, after which it shrinks in size. It plays an important role in the development of the immune system and produces lymphocytes.”).
A semiconductor diode having an extra "gate" terminal to switch it on.
Of, relating to, or being the thyroid cartilage.
Of, relating to, or being the thyroid gland.
Suggestive of a disordered thyroid gland.
An extract prepared from the thyroid gland of animals and used in treating deficiency of thyroid hormones.
A thyroid hormone, with the chemical formula C₁₅H₁₁I₄NO₄, that regulates cell metabolism and growth.
